senses.gloss: (I)--A वासिष्ठ and one of the seven sages of तामस Manu. Br. II. ३६. ४८; Vi. III. 1. १८.
(II)--a son of द्युतिमान्; after his name a Jana- pada पीवरम् in the क्रौञ्चद्वीप Va1. ३३. २१, २२; Vi. II. 4. ४८.
--a region of क्रौञ्चद्वीप (also पावन). Br. II. १९. ७२.
(I)--a daughter of Pulaha and क्षमा. Br. II. ११. ३१; वा. २८. २६.
(II)--the mind-born daughter of अग्निष्वात्त- पितृस्; becomes the wife of शुक in the २८थ् dva1para. Br. III. १०. ७७-78.

(III)--a mind-born daughter of बर्हिषद् manes who performed severe austerities and earned the title of योगमाता. The Lord blessed her to be the wife of शुक, the son of व्यास and after giving birth to four sons and a daughter she would attain salvation;
1: M. १५. 5-११.
wife of शुक.
2: Br. III. 8. ९३.

(IV)--the wife of वेदशिरस्;
1: वा. २८. 6.
sons, मार्कण्- डेयस्.
2: Br. II. ११. 8.
(V)--a R. of the केतुमाला country. वा. ४४. २२. [page२-338+ २६]
(VI)--the mind-born daughter of पितृ Dharma- मूर्तिधरस्; becomes the wife of शुक and mother of कीर्ति- मती. वा. ७३. २६.
